The main takeaway from our work is that

the scale-up should be made by increasing the number of reactors in parallel, not by enlarging each reactor, because the heat discharge from each hydrate-forming reactor is limited by the heat-transfer rate between the reactor and its surroundings, and the heat-transfer rate is inversely proportional to the surface area of the heat-transfer surface.
